profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Systems | Intelligent Automation | Python | FastAPI | React
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a passion for building intelligent software that solves real-world operational problems. I enjoy taking complex, ambiguous workflows and turning them into scalable, maintainable systems that improve how people work. 

My background spans full-stack software engineering, backend services, APIs, workflow automation, and AI-powered applications. I primarily work with Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud-based development practices, building production systems from architecture and implementation through deployment and ongoing iteration.

Over the course of my career, I've designed enterprise automation tools, integrated complex business systems, and built software that has delivered measurable operational improvements. More recently, my focus has expanded into applied AI, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, structured AI pipelines, and production AI systems that combine deterministic software with intelligent reasoning.

While my career began in enterprise unified communications and network infrastructure, that experience taught me how to build reliable systems that operate at scale, integrate across multiple platforms, and support mission-critical business operations. Those same engineering principles continue to guide the AI-powered applications and automation platforms I build today.

I enjoy working where software engineering, AI, and business problems intersect, partnering with users to understand their workflows and building tools that remove friction, improve decision-making, and create measurable impact.

positions.title: Network Engineer IV | Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop enterprise software, automation platforms, backend services, and internal applications that improve operational efficiency across large-scale engineering organizations.

Partner directly with engineering and operations teams to identify workflow inefficiencies, translate business requirements into scalable software solutions, and iterate based on user feedback. My work spans full-stack application development, REST API integration, workflow automation, and production software built with Python, Django/FastAPI, React, and PostgreSQL.

Selected Projects & Impact:

Enterprise Workflow Automation Platform – Designed and built an internal automation platform that streamlined a complex multi-system customer service workflow, including verification, auditability, status tracking, and background processing. Reduced manual effort by an estimated 526+ hours per month while improving operational consistency and visibility.

Engineering Survey & Planning Platform – Replaced a spreadsheet-based workflow that was passed between engineering design and field operations teams with a centralized internal application. The platform tracks submissions, completion status, survey progress, and project wiring costs, providing a shared source of truth and improving coordination, accountability, and visibility throughout the planning and execution process.

Reconnect Service – Built a secure self-service application enabling frontline engineers to restore customer services without escalation, eliminating operational bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate access controls and reducing business risk.

Enterprise Ticket Search – Designed and developed a web application that expanded search capabilities beyond the native ticketing system, allowing engineers to search custom attributes, locate information faster, and generate downloadable operational reports.

positions.title: Senior UCS Architect
positions.description:
Designed and implemented enterprise communications solutions for large commercial customers by translating business requirements into scalable technical architectures and deployment plans.

Partnered directly with customers, sales engineers, and implementation teams to gather requirements, design integrated solutions, and ensure successful deployment across complex enterprise environments. Served as a technical advisor throughout the project lifecycle, providing architecture guidance, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integration support.

Specialized in API integrations, systems interoperability, enterprise networking, and large-scale unified communications platforms while maintaining technical documentation and supporting production environments for mission-critical customer deployments.
